title: Supreme Court of India's SUVAS translation software: 36,271 judgments translated into Hindi and 17,142 into 16 other languages by 5 August 2024
summary: SUVAS translated 36,271 Supreme Court judgments into Hindi and 17,142 into 16 languages by 5 Aug 2024; High Courts report own totals
account: SUVAS (Supreme Court Vidhik Anuvaad Software) is the Supreme Court of India's AI-assisted tool for translating English judgments into Indian languages. A 2025 peer-reviewed article citing the Press Information Bureau reports that as on 5 August 2024, 36,271 Supreme Court judgments had been translated into Hindi and 17,142 into 16 other regional languages. The Supreme Court's Annual Report 2024-25 summarizes a judge's address crediting SUVAS with translating over 100,000 judgments into 18 regional languages, and records High Court translation work: Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, which the report says uses SUVAS, had translated 4,426 Supreme Court judgments into Urdu, and Manipur's AI-Assisted Legal Translation Committee had translated 433 Supreme Court judgments into Meetei Mayek, 259 uploaded and 174 under review, which the report describes as 'AI-assisted translation' without naming the tool. These are aggregates; no single translated judgment with a dated delivery was found.
purpose: Translate Supreme Court and High Court judgments from English into Indian languages to widen access
system: SUVAS (Supreme Court Vidhik Anuvaad Software), AI-assisted legal translation with human verification
deployer: Supreme Court of India; High Courts' SUVAS Cells and AI-assisted translation committees

ai_role.statement: Court documents attribute the translations to SUVAS with human review by translation committees; the fetched sources do not evaluate accuracy or separate machine from human contribution. The PIB release behind the 36,271/17,142 figures could not be fetched directly (its URL was not recoverable with the search tools available), so it is cited via the peer-reviewed article that quotes it.
